control: Хранить pre-1945 sources как incoming; фиксировать career/corpus continuity и политический rupture отдельно.
needed_sources: Архивы университетов; first publications; histories of occupation and postwar academy.

control: Обязательный N40; квоты покрытия по political, analytic, science, feminist, aesthetic, technology and life corpora.
needed_sources: PAJ journals; specialist societies; sourcebooks beyond Kyoto.
risk: Переводной канон и comparative religion делают одну линию чрезмерно видимой.

control: Создавать edges для конкретных wartime texts, institutions, revisions and postwar critiques.
needed_sources: Critical editions; wartime journals; scholarship on Kyoto controversy and empire.
risk: Апология и демонизация обе заменяют текстовый анализ.

control: Использовать inclusion test: sustained conceptual argument + traceable text + reception/institutional role.
needed_sources: Journal archives; disciplinary histories; author bibliographies.
problem: 哲学 tetsugaku / 思想 shisō
risk: Жёсткая граница исключает public philosophy; слишком широкая растворяет критерий аргумента.

control: Не создавать node «Japanese mind» без contested status; различать descriptive comparison and essentialism.
needed_sources: Comparative philosophy criticism; postcolonial and feminist scholarship.
risk: Nihonjinron-like framing превращает различие в готовую метафизику Японии.

control: Lexeme graph Japanese–romanization–English; authority IDs; versioned translations.
needed_sources: NDL authority data; CiNii; translators’ introductions; sourcebooks.
risk: Разные переводы одного термина выглядят как разные концепты; варианты имён дробят авторитетные записи.

control: Хранить language coverage, translation status and citation visibility per corpus.
risk: Переведённое принимается за канон; Japanese-only authors исчезают.

control: Work/version/anthology excerpt graph; не цитировать excerpt без source publication metadata.
risk: Reader вырывает текст из original journal and debate.

control: Тип `constellation`, not formal school; хранить co-location, citations and shared problems as separate evidence.
risk: Ретроспективная группировка может переутвердить формальную организацию, которой не было.

control: Оценивать argument, conceptual transformation, hermeneutics and debate, not confessional label.
risk: Буддийские и interreligious texts либо исключаются, либо включаются без философского теста.

control: Внутренний Sub-DR; regional and Japanese-language search; gender metadata and canon critique.
needed_sources: Japanese feminist anthologies; journals; institutional repositories.
risk: Кафедральные каноны и English indexes недопредставляют женщин и movement texts.

control: Frontier audit без искусственного включения; добавлять nodes только при письменном философском corpus.
needed_sources: Indigenous scholarship; regional repositories; critical race/postcolonial research.
risk: Национальный label скрывает внутреннюю колониальность и multilingual agency.

control: Развести pre-2011 environmental philosophy, disaster response, nuclear ethics and later climate lines.
needed_sources: Environmental philosophy collections; post-Fukushima special issues.

control: Каждому source record — checked_at, version, archive URL, rights and persistence status.
needed_sources: Official society/journal pages; DOI/Crossref; repository snapshots.
risk: AI/data ethics and born-digital publications быстро меняются.

contribution: Диагностика ультранационализма, authority, subject and responsibility; first-publication anchor.
reliability: Очень высокая для текста; сверять first journal issue и поздние переводы.
source_access: NDL Search; ищите по японскому заглавию. Каталог
source_label: [P01] Маруяма Масао, 「超国家主義の論理と心理」 (1946)

contribution: Being/doing, action, institution, Japanese intellectual structure; postwar canon anchor.
reliability: Очень высокая; anthology excerpt не заменяет исходную публикацию.
source_access: NDL Search; title/edition graph обязателен. Каталог
source_label: [P02] Маруяма, 「であることとすること」 (1958) и 『日本の思想』 (1961)

contribution: Modernity, Asia, resistance and critique of simple Westernization.
reliability: Высокая; различать 1948 text, revisions и English editorial framing.
source_access: Columbia University Press translation volume. Издание
source_label: [P03] Такэути Ёсими, 「近代とは何か」 / What Is Modernity?

contribution: Прагматизм, демократия, popular culture, war memory and public thought around Tsurumi networks.
reliability: Высокая как serial witness; completeness/digitization uneven.
source_label: [P04] 『思想の科学』 / Science of Thought corpus

contribution: Aidagara, ethics and social totality in a postwar-published volume of a longer project.
reliability: Очень высокая; corpus begins before 1945 and must be versioned.
source_access: NDL Search; Japanese editions and later collected works. Каталог
source_label: [P05] Вацудзи Тэцуро, 『倫理学』, т. III (1949)

contribution: Large-scale comparison of Indian, Chinese, Tibetan and Japanese conceptual habits.
reliability: Высокая; edition and essentialism critique required.
source_access: NDL Search; multiple Japanese and translated editions. Каталог
source_label: [P06] Накамура Хадзимэ, comparative ‘ways of thinking’ corpus

contribution: Consciousness, essence and semantic comparison across Asian philosophical traditions.
reliability: Очень высокая; international corpus spans Japanese/English/Arabic/Persian contexts.
source_access: NDL Search; author/title and collected works. Каталог
source_label: [P07] Идзуцу Тосихико, 『意識と本質』 (1983)

contribution: Common sense, place, body and critique of abstract rationality.
reliability: Высокая; English access is fragmentary.
source_label: [P08] Накамура Юдзиро, 『共通感覚論』 (1979)

contribution: Joint-subjective world structure, relation and post-Marxist transformation.
reliability: Высокая domestically; translation visibility low.
source_access: NDL Search; author records and collected works. Каталог
source_label: [P09] Хиромацу Ватару, relational ontology corpus

contribution: Self, between, time, clinical encounter and modes of existence.
reliability: Очень высокая; track medical vs philosophical publication contexts.
source_access: NDL Search; Japanese, German and English editions. Каталог
source_label: [P10] Кимура Бин, aida and temporality corpus

contribution: Shintai, cultivation, practice, mind–body and comparative method.
reliability: Очень высокая; English collections are selected/rearranged.
source_access: NDL Search; Japanese originals and translated collections. Каталог
source_label: [P11] Юаса Ясуо, body and East–West dialogue corpus

contribution: Appearance, person, face/mask and grammatical ontology.
reliability: Высокая; translation remains partial.
source_label: [P12] Сакабэ Мэгуми, mask/person/copula corpus

contribution: Perception, language, world and form/emptiness without school reduction.
reliability: Высокая; English excerpt selection bias.
source_label: [P13] Омори Сёдзо, language–perception–world corpus

contribution: Embodiment as lived/spiritual structure and autonomous Japanese body-philosophy.
reliability: Высокая; Japanese-only visibility limits global reception.
source_access: NDL Search; title and editions. Каталог
source_label: [P14] Итикава Хироси, 『精神としての身体』 (1975)

contribution: Kant–Marx crossing, architecture, exchange, transnational critical theory.
reliability: Очень высокая; map Japanese originals, revisions and translations.
source_access: MIT Press edition of Transcritique. Издание
source_label: [P15] Каратани Кодзин, Architecture/Being → Transcritique

contribution: Aesthetic normativity of ordinary environments, objects and care.
reliability: Очень высокая; transnational English-language node, not a proxy for all Japan.
source_label: [P16] Юрико Сайто, Everyday Aesthetics (2007)

contribution: Founded 1949; annual 『哲学』 from 1952; international journal from 2017; conference and field metadata.
reliability: Очень высокая for institutional facts; self-description requires historiographic context.
source_label: [D01] Philosophical Association of Japan / Tetsugaku

contribution: Founded 1949; Japanese 『美学』 and Western-language BIGAKU / online series; subfield scope.
reliability: Очень высокая for chronology and journal access; coverage varies by series.
source_label: [D02] Japanese Society for Aesthetics / Bigaku

contribution: Founded 1956; philosophy/foundations of science; annual English publication and J-STAGE access.
reliability: Очень высокая; journal scope ≠ whole Japanese analytic field.
source_label: [D03] Japan Association for Philosophy of Science / Annals

contribution: Conferences, journal and institutional continuity of phenomenology in Japan.
reliability: Высокая; exact predecessor/version chronology should be checked in Japanese.
source_label: [D04] Phenomenological Association of Japan

contribution: Interreligious, Buddhist, Kyoto-line and modern Japanese thought; English translation/publication interface.
reliability: Очень высокая as institutional/access gateway; field crosses philosophy and religious studies.
source_label: [D05] Nanzan Institute + Japanese Journal of Religious Studies

contribution: Full text, DOI/issue metadata and retrospective access to many Japanese society journals.
reliability: Очень высокая for discovery/access; OCR and backfile completeness vary.
source_label: [D06] J-STAGE

contribution: Articles, books, projects, researchers and institutional links across Japanese academia.
reliability: Очень высокая for discovery; duplicate/metadata normalization required.
source_label: [D07] CiNii Research

contribution: Edition, serial and authority discovery; scans where rights permit.
reliability: Очень высокая; access restrictions and OCR quality must be recorded.
source_label: [D08] National Diet Library Search + Digital Collections

contribution: Japanese university repository records and OA full texts, including theses and bulletins.
reliability: Высокая; repository coverage, embargo and link persistence vary.
source_label: [D09] IRDB — Institutional Repositories DataBase

contribution: Contemporary philosophy of life, death, bioethics and meaning; full-text articles/books.
reliability: Высокая for accessible corpus; platform governance and long-term preservation need audit.
source_label: [D10] Journal of Philosophy of Life / OA books

contribution: Базовая карта периодов, фигур, проблем и современного состояния поля; полезна для boundary and terminology.
limitations: Широкий синтез; не заменяет японскоязычную журнальную историю.
source_label: [S01] Stanford Encyclopedia of Philosophy — Japanese Philosophy (rev. 2026)

contribution: История эстетических понятий и modern reception; вход в everyday/environmental aesthetics.
limitations: Сильнее традиционных понятий, чем институциональной истории postwar journals.
source_label: [S02] SEP — Japanese Aesthetics

contribution: Главная современной архитектура японской философии; отдельные главы по postwar political philosophy, phenomenology, ethics and comparison.
limitations: Глава ≠ исчерпывающий corpus; English editorial canon.
source_label: [S03] Bret W. Davis, ed., The Oxford Handbook of Japanese Philosophy

contribution: Переводные первичные тексты, историческая связность и терминологический вход.
limitations: Селекция и excerpting; original Japanese and first publication must be recovered.
source_label: [S04] Heisig, Kasulis, Maraldo, Japanese Philosophy: A Sourcebook (2011)

contribution: Наиболее прямой обзор contemporary field: science, peace, justice, healing, disaster, aesthetics, gender and life.
limitations: Неравномерная глубина глав; англоязычная presentation layer.
source_label: [S05] Michiko Yusa, ed., Bloomsbury Research Handbook of Contemporary Japanese Philosophy (2017)

contribution: Ключевой postwar reader: Maruyama, Izutsu, Yuasa, Ueda, Ōmori, Nakamura, Kimura, Hiromatsu, Sakabe, Karatani и feminist framing.
limitations: Поздний anthology canon; большинство selections требуют возврата к original edition.
source_label: [S06] John W. M. Krummel, ed., Contemporary Japanese Philosophy: A Reader (2019)

contribution: Длинная карта modern schools and figures; полезна как older historiographic baseline.
limitations: Периодизация и оценки устарели; заканчивается 1994 годом.
source_label: [S07] Gino K. Piovesana, Recent Japanese Philosophical Thought, 1862–1994

contribution: Альтернативная антологическая карта modern Japanese philosophy и translation history.
limitations: Selection bias; limited post-1990 coverage.
source_label: [S08] Dilworth, Viglielmo, Jacinto, Sourcebook for Modern Japanese Philosophy (1998)

contribution: Маруяма, autonomy, democracy and postwar political-philosophical institutionality.
limitations: Author-centered; не описывает всё поле.
source_label: [S09] Rikki Kersten, Democracy in Postwar Japan: Maruyama Masao and the Search for Autonomy (1996)

contribution: Классическое исследование postwar shutaisei debate across Marxist, liberal and other positions.
limitations: Интеллектуальная история; не исчерпывает later philosophy.
source_label: [S10] J. Victor Koschmann, Revolution and Subjectivity in Postwar Japan (1996)

contribution: Marxian and modernist traditions, Maruyama and relation of philosophy/social science.
limitations: Смежное поле; требует философского inclusion test per text.
source_label: [S11] Andrew E. Barshay, The Social Sciences in Modern Japan (2004)

contribution: ICT, robots, energy, geoengineering, Fukushima and technology ethics in Japanese contexts.
limitations: Современный edited snapshot; не единая Japanese doctrine.
source_label: [S12] Lennerfors & Murata, eds., Tetsugaku Companion to Japanese Ethics and Technology (2019)

contribution: Карта environmental thought, nature, place, Buddhist and modern resources.
limitations: Риск heritage-essentialism; проверять normative arguments and local voices.
source_label: [S13] Callicott & McRae, eds., Japanese Environmental Philosophy (2017)

contribution: Everyday aesthetics, world-making, care, familiar environments and normative implications.
limitations: Транснациональный English corpus; не вся postwar Japanese aesthetics.
source_label: [S14] Yuriko Saito, Aesthetics of the Familiar (2017)

contribution: Аргументы о sex, love, labour, family and feminism across a century; source map for postwar feminist seed.
limitations: Не все участницы self-identify as philosophers; нужен text-level philosophical test.
source_label: [S15] Ayako Kano, Japanese Feminist Debates (2016)

contribution: Pluralizes Japanese feminisms, regional/social locations and historical continuity.
limitations: Шире философии; полезен для frontier mapping, не автоматического inclusion.
source_label: [S16] Bullock, Kano, Welker, eds., Rethinking Japanese Feminisms

contribution: Embodiment, selfhood, Continental, Japanese and feminist philosophy; correction to disembodied comparison.
limitations: External comparative reconstruction; must be tied back to Japanese texts.
source_label: [S17] Erin McCarthy, Ethics Embodied (2010)

contribution: Race, feminism, Asian identity, disciplinary invisibility and claims to philosophy.
limitations: Transnational US context; not a survey of Japanese feminist philosophy.
source_label: [S18] Yoko Arisaka, “Asian Women: Invisibility, Locations, and Claims to Philosophy” (2000)

contribution: Documents the early and continuing interaction between phenomenology and Japanese philosophy; strong bridge to body/aida lines.
limitations: Edited thematic frame; varies by chapter and often includes pre-1945 materials.
source_label: [S19] Taguchi & Altobrando, eds., Tetsugaku Companion to Phenomenology and Japanese Philosophy (2019)

contribution: Methodological critique of how ‘Japanese philosophy’ is constructed, translated and made.
limitations: Authorial synthesis; series scope and volumes must be versioned.
source_label: [S20] John C. Maraldo, Japanese Philosophy in the Making

contribution: Readable but scholarly long-duration map; helps place postwar corpora without treating 1945 as absolute beginning.
limitations: Broad synthesis; contemporary details less granular than specialist research.
source_label: [S21] Thomas P. Kasulis, Engaging Japanese Philosophy: A Short History (2018)
